subject: Onboarding: invoice routing, PO activation, and early payment incentive proposal
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: invoice routing, PO activation, and early payment incentive proposal

Hi Leah,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference as a supplier partner — excited to get Acme Cloud set up. To move vendor activation forward we need the standard onboarding packet plus the AP routing details so we can map invoices to the right PO and pay cycle.

What we need from your side:
- Completed vendor_onboarding_form (attached) and W-9
- AP contact (name/email) for invoice submission and remittance questions
- Your preferred invoice PDF layout or sample (if you have a required PO number placement)
- Bank details or ACH onboarding instructions (we can share a secure portal link)

On terms: our default for new strategic suppliers is Net 45 to align with our monthly close, but we run an early-payment incentive program for volume partners. Proposal: Net 45 standard, or 1.5% discount if invoice is paid within 15 days (Net 15). If that is a hard no, please tell us what your preferred terms are and we can propose a middle ground.

Next steps: please return the attached form + W-9, confirm AP contact, and let me know if Acme can accept the early-payment discount structure above. Once we have that we'll issue a PO and route invoices to accounts@redwoodinference.com with the PO number in the subject line.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)]

Rishi — thanks for the clear checklist and the quick turnaround.

Attached are the W-9 and a short sample invoice (sample_invoice_0927.pdf). Our AP prefers Net 30 for SaaS/usage invoices; however, we can evaluate an early-pay discount. We typically offer 1.0% for payment within 15 days (Net 15) for accounts that set ACH on file.

AP contact: Jessica Huang (jessica.huang@acmecorp.com). Please send PO numbers to accounts@acmecorp.com and copy Jessica if there are routing exceptions.

I'm attaching the W-9 now. We'll review Redwood's proposed 1.5% and get back to you by EOD — quick note though: larger discounts require approval from finance.

Attachments: W-9_AcmeCloud.pdf, sample_invoice_0927.pdf

Best,

Subject: RE: Onboarding: invoice routing, PO activation, and early payment incentive proposal

Hi Leah / Rishi — looping in Finance (Monica) to expedite approvals.

Quick background from our side: for new vendors we standardize on Net 45 so month-end close is predictable. That said, we do run a graduated early-pay program — our target is to align incentives so our unit economics remain stable. Proposed options:

- Option A (preferred): Net 45, 1.25% discount if invoice is paid within 10 days (Net 10).
- Option B: Net 45, 0.75% discount if invoice is paid within 15 days (Net 15).
- Option C: Net 30 with 0.5% discount for Net 10 (only for high-frequency low-dollar invoices).

If Acme can accept ACH + an automated remittance feed, Option B is our easiest operational path and requires the least manual reconciliation. For legal/PO flow: we'll issue a PO once we have the onboarding form/W-9 and the name of the Redwood contact who will approve each invoice. We can also send a DocuSign for a short MSA amendment if Acme prefers that instead of a PO-first workflow.

Can you confirm which option Acme prefers and whether Jessica can accept ACH onboarding? If yes, we'll follow up with a DocuSign link and the PO.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pricing_incentive_grid.xlsx (Excel) — internal]

Marissa / Rishi — thanks for the options and for making the PO flow clear. I've confirmed with AP and Finance: Acme can accept Option B (Net 45, 0.75% discount for payment within 15 days) and Jessica confirmed ACH onboarding is acceptable — she can send an ACH authorization link.

We have attached the completed W-9 and our bank remittance instructions (we'll send the detailed ACH link to Jessica directly). Please go ahead and issue the initial PO so we can start billing next cycle. I'll expect the DocuSign link if you prefer that for the MSA amendment.

Attachments: W-9_AcmeCloud.pdf
